_note: SYNTHETIC demo data. Companies are real public companies; people and conversations are fictional.

deals.summary: Discussed an AI assistant to triage K-Rauta B2B customer service emails and draft replies. Proposal covered a 12-week rollout in one chain.
deals.objection: Procurement requires a group-level vendor assessment, and the timeline is unclear.

thread.text: Hi Heikki, attached is the proposal for the email triage assistant. It includes a 12-week plan, KPIs for response time, and a fixed-price pilot option.
Thanks, the content looks good. Group procurement has to assess new vendors first, and I don't yet know when we'll get a slot.
Understood. We can send the security and GDPR materials now so the assessment can start earlier. Shall I share them with procurement directly?

deals.summary: Mapped manual steps in waste collection route planning and invoicing exceptions. Identified automation candidates in back-office work.
deals.objection: The team is busy with year-end and the budget for next year is not yet confirmed.

thread.text: Thanks for the workshop, Marjo. We summarized five automation candidates in invoicing exceptions. Would a 30-minute review in December work?
Good summary. Let's pick this up after the budget is confirmed in Q1, since December is full of year-end work.

deals.summary: Planned a pilot for a spare-parts search assistant that uses manuals and service history. Scope was agreed in principle.
deals.objection: IT wants to see where the data is processed before approving a pilot.

thread.text: Here is the pilot scope: the assistant would index manuals and parts catalogs for two markets over 8 weeks. We can host the data in the EU.
Sounds fine to me. IT needs a detailed data-flow diagram before they'll approve the pilot, and they have a long queue.

deals.summary: Proposed automating the handling of parcel-claim inquiries with an AI agent integrated into the existing CRM.
deals.objection: An internal automation program is already running, so there are doubts about overlap and priority.

thread.text: Johanna, the proposal is attached. It automates claim classification and first replies, with human handover. Expected 35% reduction in handling time.
We have a related internal program underway. I need to check with the program lead how this fits before I can commit to anything.

deals.summary: Introduced AI-generated product descriptions and translations for the webshops across markets.
deals.objection: Brand voice is sensitive, and the team is unsure whether the AI output meets quality standards.

thread.text: Thanks for the call, Elina. We can run a free test on 20 products in your brand tone and let your team compare against the originals.
Interesting, but our brand team is cautious about AI text. Let me discuss internally whether a test is even acceptable.

deals.summary: Explored personalization of loyalty campaigns using purchase history and automated segmentation.
deals.objection: The CRM platform migration takes priority and consumes the team's capacity.

thread.text: We're in the middle of a CRM platform migration. Personalization is high on the wishlist but the team has no capacity until it's done.
Makes sense. We could prepare the segmentation logic on your current data so it plugs into the new platform. Want a short plan?

deals.summary: Proposal for demand forecasting automation across stores and seasonal categories.
deals.objection: The CFO considers the price high relative to the current forecasting accuracy.

thread.text: Jari, the forecasting proposal is attached. Based on your data, a 10% improvement in accuracy would pay back the investment within about 9 months.
Our CFO thinks the price is high compared to what we have now. Could you propose a smaller first step?

deals.summary: Pilot for AI summarization of building service reports and automated work-order creation.
deals.objection: Waiting for a customer contract renewal to determine which sites to include.

thread.text: For the pilot we suggest three sites with the highest report volume. We can start within two weeks of your go-ahead.
We're waiting on a customer contract renewal that affects site selection. I'll come back as soon as it's decided.

deals.summary: Discussed embedding an AI assistant into their ERP product for SME customers, with Velho as an implementation partner.
deals.objection: The product roadmap is already full, and they are unsure whether to build in-house or partner.

thread.text: We outlined two models: co-developing the assistant or delivering it as a white-label module. Happy to walk you through the trade-offs.
Thanks. Our roadmap is full through autumn and we're debating build vs. partner internally. I'll get back to you.

deals.summary: Proposed automating appointment reminders, rescheduling, and referral intake using an AI agent.
deals.objection: Legal and data protection review of patient data handling is taking longer than expected.

thread.text: Outi, we've updated the proposal so no patient data goes to the language model. Only anonymized intents are processed. Is that helpful for legal?
That helps, but our legal and DPO teams still need to review the architecture. Their schedule is tight, so this will take weeks.

deals.role: Chief Digital Officer's Office, Program Manager
deals.summary: Brief intro on AI-supported documentation for clinic back-office tasks.
deals.objection: They already have a large vendor partner for AI and don't see a gap.

thread.text: Thanks for the intro, Kalle. Our focus is the small back-office workflows that large platforms often skip. Can we show two examples?
Appreciate it, but we have a strategic AI partner already. I don't currently see where you'd fit. Let's keep in touch.

deals.summary: Reviewed phone-queue load in the contact center and options for AI call summaries and callback automation.
deals.objection: The decision-maker changed after an internal reorganization.

thread.text: Leena, we've prepared a call-volume analysis and three automation options. Can we present them to your management team in January?
Our organization changed and responsibilities moved. I'm not sure anymore who owns this. I'll find out and let you know.

deals.summary: Pilot on automating customer order intake from emails and PDFs into the ERP.
deals.objection: The pilot was agreed verbally, but the ERP team cannot support the integration until spring.

thread.text: We'd like to proceed with the order-intake pilot, but the ERP team can't support the integration before spring.
We can start with a read-only version that outputs structured files, so no ERP work is required initially. Shall we outline it?

deals.summary: Proposal for AI-based analysis and automated reporting of retail sell-out data.
deals.objection: The business unit supports it, but central IT wants it standardized on an existing analytics platform.

thread.text: Tiina, attached is the proposal for automated weekly sell-out reporting with anomaly alerts. It can run on your existing data platform.
We like it, but central IT wants new solutions to be built on our standard analytics platform. I need to clarify what that means.

deals.summary: Introduced workflows for automating content localization and campaign asset production.
deals.objection: Summer holidays are approaching, and the topic is not a priority this year.

thread.text: Riikka, as promised, here are two examples of localization automation from other consumer brands. Happy to do a short demo in June.
Thanks, interesting. Holidays are coming and this isn't a priority for this year's plan. Perhaps check back in the autumn.

deals.summary: Discussed automating purchase invoice matching and month-end accruals.
deals.objection: The finance team is changing ERP versions and wants to wait until the upgrade is complete.

thread.text: Mikko, based on the process walkthrough we estimate about 60% of invoice matching can be automated. Shall we draft a scope?
Good numbers. We're upgrading our ERP version this year, so I'd rather wait until that's done before changing processes.

deals.summary: Pilot for AI enrichment and cleaning of product data for 50,000 SKUs.
deals.objection: Supplier data licensing questions are unresolved.

thread.text: The pilot would enrich and normalize 5,000 SKUs in six weeks, with accuracy checks by your team. Ready to start when you are.
We still need to check whether our supplier agreements allow data to be processed with external AI tools. Waiting for legal.

deals.summary: Proposal for a quote-assistant tool that speeds up responses to contractor inquiries.
deals.objection: Sales leadership wants references from other wholesalers in the Nordics.

thread.text: Sanna, the proposal for the quote assistant is attached. It reads inquiry emails and drafts quotes from your price lists for rep approval.
Leadership wants to see references from other Nordic wholesalers before moving. Do you have any you can share?

deals.summary: Explored AI analysis of site diaries and delay notices to predict schedule risks.
deals.objection: Needs an internal sponsor in a business unit before the topic can move forward.

thread.text: Petri, we put together a sample risk dashboard based on anonymized diary entries. Would a business unit lead like to see it?
Nice sample. Right now it lacks a sponsor in the business units, and without one I can't take it further.

deals.summary: Quick intro on automating project cost reporting from several systems.
deals.objection: Considers the topic interesting but too small to justify an external vendor right now.

thread.text: Hanna, here's a one-page outline for automated project cost reporting. We could deliver the first version in about four weeks.
Thanks. It's interesting, but the issue feels too small for an external vendor at the moment. We'll revisit if the pain increases.

deals.summary: Proposed an AI chat and email assistant for customer inquiries on electricity contracts and billing.
deals.objection: Public-sector-style competitive tendering requirements may apply, and procurement is reviewing it.

thread.text: Juha-Pekka, the updated proposal is attached with a phased scope to keep each phase below your direct-award threshold if applicable.
Thanks. Procurement is still reviewing whether we need to run a formal competitive process. I can't commit until that's clear.

deals.summary: Discussed AI-based reporting for plant operation data and maintenance notes.
deals.objection: Operational data is in a segregated network, and the security team is reluctant.

thread.text: We can work with exported data, with no connection to the operational network. Would that address the security team's concern?
Possibly, but security would still need to approve exports. They are hesitant about anything touching plant data. I'll raise it.

deals.summary: Pilot on automating price monitoring and competitor assortment tracking.
deals.objection: The budget was frozen until the new year after a restructuring of the budget cycle.

thread.text: Lauri, the pilot plan is ready: price monitoring for 10 categories over 8 weeks. We can begin in January if you confirm.
We like the plan, but the budget is frozen until the new year. Let's talk again in January once things are clearer.

deals.summary: Proposal for an AI assistant handling warranty and return inquiries with order-system lookups.
deals.objection: The team is concerned about customer experience risk and wants a smaller scope.

thread.text: Noora, attached is the proposal. The assistant only handles returns and warranty status at first, with easy escalation to your agents.
Thanks. The team worries about customer experience risk. Could you make a version limited to drafting replies for agents only?

deals.summary: Reviewed service report processing and spare-parts quoting for crane maintenance operations.
deals.objection: Global IT and a larger transformation program control which tools can be adopted.

thread.text: Esa, thanks for the discussion. We drafted a regional pilot for service report processing that fits within local discretion. Thoughts?
Good idea in principle, but tool choices are decided by global IT within the transformation program. I need to see if exceptions exist.

deals.summary: Intro on automating the creation and updating of technical documentation and multilingual manuals.
deals.objection: Documentation quality and accuracy requirements are very strict, and they doubt AI reliability.

thread.text: Katriina, we can add review steps and source citations so every generated line can be traced to the original spec. Happy to demo.
Thanks. Our accuracy requirements are very strict and I'm not convinced AI is reliable enough yet. Perhaps later.

deals.summary: Proposal for automating agent partner inquiries and parcel tracking exceptions.
deals.objection: The decision is waiting for the new CEO's review of ongoing investments.

thread.text: Olli, the proposal for partner-inquiry automation is attached. Phase one is small: 6 weeks and a fixed price.
Management is reviewing all ongoing investments after the leadership change. I can't get a decision until that's finished.

deals.summary: Pilot on AI candidate matching and automated shift-filling messages.
deals.objection: The pilot depends on access to the recruitment system API, which the vendor has not yet provided.

thread.text: We want to run the pilot, but our system vendor hasn't given us API access yet and keeps postponing.
We can begin with CSV exports to prove value while waiting for the API. Would your team be able to provide weekly exports?

deals.summary: Discussed AI support for production planning around harvest-driven volume variability.
deals.objection: Harvest season takes the team's full attention until autumn.

thread.text: Sami, we prepared a simple model concept for harvest-based planning using last year's volumes. Could we review it in July?
Looks promising, but the season takes all our attention until autumn. Let's schedule a proper session in September.

deals.summary: Introduced automation of care documentation summaries and staff scheduling notifications.
deals.objection: Needs buy-in from regional directors, and sensitive-data concerns raised by the privacy team.

thread.text: Marika, thank you for the call. We can design the solution so that no personal health data leaves your environment. Want a one-page overview?
Yes please, send the overview. I'll need regional directors' support and the privacy team will have questions.
Overview attached, including a data-handling diagram. Happy to join a session with the regional directors and privacy team.
